args.summary: Built and checked an OpenSeesPy 2D spine-beam model for a four-span continuous cast-in-place prestressed box girder (30+40+40+30 m), including the specified PTFE/plain elastomeric bearings and three twin-column piers. Integrated section properties: A=8.45 m², I=4.9374 m⁴. Girder self-weight is 223.925 kN/m using the owner-specified 26.5 kN/m³; C50 Ec=34,500 MPa and C40 pier Ec=32,500 MPa. Modal analysis gave f1=3.1385 Hz and JTG D60 impact factor μ=0.1864. Generated model passed L1/L2/L3 checks. Key results: support reactions [2451, 8658, 9120, 8686, 2435] kN; max positive self-weight span moment 15,814 kN·m and max negative support moment −30,716 kN·m; lane-load max positive/negative moments 11,319/−8,972 kN·m. Script: ${PROJECT_ROOT}/runs_luna/C5/C06_r2/C06_model.py
